about: Which verification labels make a row eligible for the staged library. Labels are matched case-insensitively and are never rewritten. Only the project owner changes this file.

aiReviewEligible.note: AI review under the owner's authorized review workflow. Eligible for staging; not independently human verified, and must never be presented as such.

aiReviewConditional.rule: Eligible only if the review endorsed the final corrected row and left no unresolved concern. Per-row determinations are in revision-reviews.json and lapse if the row changes.
